reviews.review_msg: i would never take a class with this prof. made us do multiple assignments using AI, which in a 300 level class about law and justice is odd imo. minimal to no feedback on my work and basically navigated the entire class blindly until i got my grade back a full month after the class ended.

Azadeh is a nice prof and she clearly cares about what she is teaching. My only real gripes about the way her class is run is the fact that AI self-reflections are a decent chunk of your grade which seems unnecessary. That being said, she taught the content well, and teaches you how to write compelling arguments in great detail.

Great prof for any interdisciplinary look at literature. He gives amazing feedback on assignments, creates a great classroom environment, gives entertaining lectures, and is very available for extra help. Make sure you plan ahead. The multiple assignments can become overwhelming quickly if you leave things for the last minute.
